title: Chapter 2873 - 149: Witch Vulture God Descent (3)
content:
Chapter 2873: Chapter 149: Witch Vulture God Descent (3)

"If we encounter a major event that remains undecided, the tribal council shall be held by the chieftains and the chief elder to conduct discussions and decisions."

"The purpose of this alliance is to eliminate the Wujiu Tribe army in the war against the barbarian soldiers."

"And to destroy the shaman forces of the Wujiu Tribe in the divine war."

"The Wujiu Great God is an ancient deity of the Barbaric Wilderness, beyond the power of humans to contend. Therefore, the aim of this battle is to do everything we can to kill all the shamans and witch cultivators of the Wujiu Tribe, disrupt the ’Descent’ ritual, and prevent the descent of the Wujiu Great God. Otherwise, the Vermilion Bird Mountain Realm would lose faith and face utter disaster..."

All the chieftains, chief elders, even the barbarian generals stood up, placed their hands across their chests, and performed the great tribal ceremony:

"We solemnly follow the will of the honorable shaman..."

"Our tribe shall devote itself to protecting the ancestral mountain realm, resisting the external enemies of the Wujiu, and blocking the external deities."

"If we break this alliance, may heaven not pardon us!"

The resolute oath echoed powerfully.

Mo Hua stood among the crowd, his eyes flickering, without speaking.

...

At this point, the matter of alliance had reached preliminary decision.

All tribes began hurried preparations to advance the development of the war.

Upon returning to the tribe, Mo Hua sought out Dan Zhu and asked, "You have a sister named Dan Ling?"

Dan Zhu nodded, "Yes, gentleman."

Mo Hua asked curiously, "Is she very beautiful?"

When Yan Zhu mentioned Dan Ling, he described her as being like a "beautiful jade," like a "Vermilion Bird," as brilliant as red jade.

When saying these words, Yan Zhu’s divine thought was filled with an uncontrollable desire, like a wicked fire surging restlessly.

This fluctuation of desire at the divine sense level was unknown to others, but Mo Hua, who had learned Divine Sense Sublimation and Planting Devil in Taoist Heart, perceived it clearly.

Yan Zhu, being an Upper Witch with late Golden Core stage cultivation serving the Great Wilderness Royal Court, having seen the grand world, should not be so unable to suppress his desires.

The only possibility was that Dan Ling was indeed very beautiful, breaking through Yan Zhu’s defenses of desire.

Even stranger, Qing Zhu seemed to also be very fond of this Dan Ling.

This made Mo Hua very concerned.

Dan Zhu replied, "Probably..."

Mo Hua was puzzled, "What do you mean by probably?"

Dan Zhu said, "I saw my sister when I was young; she held me, vaguely, and she was indeed very beautiful. But it was many years ago, I don’t know how my sister looks now, nor if what I remember still holds true..."

Mo Hua slowly nodded.

Dan Zhu looked at Mo Hua, hesitated for a long time, and finally couldn’t help but ask:

"Gentleman, why are you asking if my sister is beautiful?"

Mo Hua paused and said seriously, "It’s related to the heavenly mechanism causality, and cannot be revealed at this time."

"Oh..." Dan Zhu nodded, without expressing an opinion.

Mo Hua looked at Dan Zhu again, his expression slightly more serious, and asked, "Have you thought through that previous question?"

Dan Zhu was slightly taken aback by the words, his expression serious, his eyes dimming a bit, seemingly hesitant to meet Mo Hua’s gaze.

After a moment, he took a deep breath, looked into Mo Hua’s eyes, and nodded seriously:

"Gentleman, I have thought it over."

"In one’s life, ultimately one must have a Taoist heart. If my father and brother are on the same path as me, naturally we should unite our efforts, but if not, I will never back down."

Having gone through manifold hardships and the tempering of war, Dan Zhu’s gaze became increasingly steadfast, his Taoist heart more resilient.

Mo Hua confirmed Dan Zhu’s eyes and slightly nodded, "Good."

He simply wanted Dan Zhu to come to this realization early.

As for whether it would develop into father and sons turning against each other, brothers becoming enemies, Mo Hua naturally did not want his "disciple" Dan Zhu to be too troubled.

It still depends on the capability of this "gentleman."

The Vermilion Bird Ancient Divine Altar.

Wujiu Great God...

Mo Hua, with deep gaze, silently mused in his heart:

"Just wondering whether this Wujiu God is really big enough, enough to let me... swallow whole the twenty-four patterns..."
